user.title: Configure Smart Thermostat
user.description: Set up a smart thermostat that reacts to live energy prices. ⚠ Requires the HACS Nordpool integration (NOT the built-in HA Nordpool).

data_description.control_mode: Choose whether to change tolerances (switch control) or nudge a smart thermostat's set-point (temperature control).
data_description.target_sensor: Sensor that represents the room temperature you care about (e.g. remote probe). Required.
data_description.internal_sensor: Thermostat's own temperature sensor (if different from remote). Used for offset calculations.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional outdoor sensor for smarter cooling/heating decisions.
data_description.target_climate: Thermostat entity whose set-point should be adjusted (used in temperature control mode).
data_description.heater: Switch or entity that turns the heater on/off (tolerance mode).
data_description.cooler: Switch or entity that turns the cooler/AC on/off (tolerance mode).
data_description.price_sensor: Main Nordpool sensor (e.g. sensor.nordpool_kwh_no1_nok). Must expose 'raw_today' attribute.
data_description.max_tolerance: When energy is expensive the system allows the room to cool/heat by up to this amount before reacting.
data_description.min_tolerance: Tolerance at average price (the two curves cross here).
data_description.max_offset: Upper bound for how much the thermostat set-point can be increased (temperature mode).
data_description.min_offset: Lower bound for how much the thermostat set-point can be decreased (temperature mode).
data_description.heat_offset: Degrees to add when remote temperature is below desired (temperature mode).
data_description.cool_offset: Degrees to add when remote is above desired (usually negative to force cooling).
data_description.base_stop_heat_offset: Offset applied when remote temperature reaches the target.
data_description.max_stop_heat_offset: Minimum offset when remote is well above target (prevents overshoot).
data_description.temperature_tolerance: Comfort band around desired temperature before corrective action is taken.
data_description.fan_only_difference: If the room exceeds desired temperature by this many degrees, fan-only can be used.
data_description.cool_indoor_threshold: Start cooling if indoor temperature exceeds this threshold.
data_description.cool_outdoor_threshold: Allow cooling when outdoor temperature is above this value.
data_description.cool_indoor_min: Minimum indoor temperature before cooling logic engages.
data_description.enable_fan_only_mode: Use fan-only mode where available to save energy.
data_description.allow_hvac_mode_changes: Permit Smartmostat to change the HVAC mode on the thermostat (temperature mode).
data_description.enable_diagnostic_logging: Emit detailed logs and fire metric events for analytics.
data_description.lookahead_hours: How many hours ahead to scan price data for upcoming expensive periods.
data_description.preconditioning_enabled: Pre-heat or pre-cool before expensive periods to store thermal energy.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity could not be found
error.invalid_price_sensor: This sensor doesn't expose hourly price data. Use the HACS Nordpool integration (sensor.nordpool_kwh_*).
error.missing_output_device: Select at least a heater or cooler when using tolerance control mode.
error.invalid_control_mode: The selected control mode is not recognised.
